patterns.note: A continuous, multi-stop dark blue to purple gradient serves as the primary background across the entire page, creating a unified and immersive visual field rather than distinct section backgrounds.
Asymmetrical two-column content blocks are frequently used, pairing a prominent image or graphic with descriptive text and a call-to-action button.
Large, bold sans-serif headings are used for impact on dark backgrounds, complemented by smaller, lighter-weight body text and occasional small, uppercase labels.
Content sections and individual elements within them reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they scroll into the viewport, enhancing engagement and guiding the user's eye.
Prominent full-width quote sections feature oversized typography and a central, abstract graphic element to break up content and emphasize key messages.

technique_notes: Implement scroll-triggered animations using a library like Lottie (as detected) for specific elements (e.g., the 'Scroll for More' indicator) and a scroll-animation framework (e.g., GSAP ScrollTrigger) to reveal content blocks. Elements should animate into view with a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect as their parent section enters the viewport.

Create a continuous, multi-stop linear gradient background that spans the entire page height, giving the impression of a single, deep canvas rather than distinct section backgrounds. This gradient should subtly shift colors as the user scrolls.
Design call-to-action buttons with a high-contrast solid fill color (e.g., bright yellow) and subtle rounded corners, ensuring they stand out against the dark, gradient backgrounds.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (hero ~3-4x body) with clean, legible body text and small, often uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons and image containers; circular for headshots.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in hero and major statement sections, balanced in content grids and feature blocks.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its continuous, deep gradient background that spans the entire page, creating a sophisticated and immersive visual experience that feels less like distinct sections and more like a unified canvas. This, combined with strategic bright yellow accents and subtle scroll-triggered reveals, gives the site a premium, scientific, and modern feel that avoids typical blocky section structures.
